'''Waterbirth Dungeon''' is a large [[dungeons|dungeon]] found on [[Waterbirth Island]] and consists of several sublevels that contain powerful, [[aggressive]] [[monster]]s. Players must be prepared to encounter all three [[combat styles]]. Few [[safespots]] are available, so those adventurers who wish to explore the dungeon must take caution.
